intro.text: You know the whole home row now – that’s nine letters and a semicolon! Let’s put them together into real words.
intro.tip: Find a steady rhythm, like a ticking clock. Even and smooth beats fast and bumpy.

steps.title: Warm-up words
steps.instructions: Start gently with words from the left side of the home row.

steps.title: Stretch to G and H
steps.instructions: These words reach into the middle of the row.

steps.title: All together
steps.instructions: Any home row word can turn up now.

steps.title: Hands-on challenge
text: a lass has a glad dash; dad shall ask all lads; half a salad falls; a flag has a flash;
all lads had a glass; dad has a flask; a sad lass asks a lad; glad dads shall dash;
steps.instructions: Keyboard hints fade out – you’ve got this.
